units: pixels (image coords, x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale

camera.evidence: phase correlation of the sofa/right-floor region vs frame 0: |shift| < 0.04 px in all 50 frames
camera.view: orthographic-like top-down (bird's-eye) view of a living room; motion is in the floor plane, which faces the camera. Treat as 2D: one px->m scale for the floor plane. Objects on the floor (both animals) are at about the same depth; tall props (lamp top, console top) are slightly closer to the camera.
camera.lighting_note: sun patches / window-bar shadows on the floor shift and change brightness during the clip (not camera motion)

tan_animal.track: tracks/tan_animal.csv (fur + head patch)  and  tracks/tan_animal_fur_only.csv (fur only, cleaner mask)
